   **Баги и стабильность.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 23 сент. 2026 г. - 10 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _I C_, 10 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "I would love to love this app, unfortunately it simply doesn't work on my phone. I crashes when I try to create a new document and it crashes when I try to open one too. What a shame :("
            2. _Mein Name_, 3 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "completely useless if in spreadsheets lines do not stick together when sorting. It's also buggy as hell. When I tap "freeze row" nothing happens. And for some reason it keeps overwriting while I am typing. a complete mess but I would have still used it if I could sort my data correctly."
            3. _Monitor ePublications AR_, 25 сент. 2026 г., 2/5: "Won't open password protected files as of 9-26, prior to that usually stable. Known new issue, awaiting fix."
